kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: We've designed and built our first AI chip: Jalapeño, brought to production with Broadcom, purpose-built for the LLM workloads powering ChatGPT, Codex, the API and future agentic products.
kept_items.selection_reason: Headline release of the day: OpenAI's first in-house AI chip with Broadcom. Official source, 3.6M views, corroborated by gdb.

kept_items.author: PatrickToulme
kept_items.text: OpenAI's Jalapeño is most likely the first chip virtually entirely developed by Codex/GPT, with the software stack and most of the hardware design coded by an internal model.
kept_items.selection_reason: Distinct analytical angle on the chip news: claims most of the design was produced by OpenAI's own coding models.

kept_items.author: OpenAI
kept_items.text: A new version of GPT-5.5 Instant, more fun to talk to, better at understanding intent, handling complex constraints and shopping.
kept_items.selection_reason: Official model update: new GPT-5.5 Instant. Distinct OpenAI story (caps allow 2).

kept_items.author: MervinPraison
kept_items.text: Z.ai released GLM 5.2, an open-source model for coding and software engineering, 1M-token context, strong coding benchmarks, MIT licensed.
kept_items.selection_reason: Open-source model release: GLM 5.2, MIT licensed, clearest factual account.

kept_items.author: VaibhavSisinty
kept_items.text: Alibaba open sourced an AI agent model called Qwen-AgentWorld, said to beat closed models.
kept_items.selection_reason: Open-source agent model release from Alibaba; distinct from GLM 5.2.

kept_items.author: a16z
kept_items.text: a16z leads Mirendil's $200M seed round; MirendilAI trains frontier models expert at AI R&D and builds the product around it.
kept_items.selection_reason: Funding news: a16z leads a $200M seed for an AI R&D startup. Official investor source.

kept_items.author: hugolowell
kept_items.text: WIRED: the Trump administration has been happier talking to Anthropic as it tries to get its most powerful models back online, encouraged that CEO Dario Amodei has been swapped out of those talks.
kept_items.selection_reason: Company/policy reporting from a WIRED journalist on Anthropic's negotiations to restore its models.

kept_items.author: vida_agent
kept_items.text: Launching Vida, a proactive agent that understands context, remembers what matters, anticipates intent and delivers production-grade outcomes.
kept_items.selection_reason: Product launch: Vida, a proactive agent. 980K views.

kept_items.author: ashwingop
kept_items.text: Claude Tag is a Trojan horse, not because Anthropic is evil but because the incentives are obvious: tag Claude in Slack, let it follow the thread, remember context, connect to tools and act.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong practitioner analysis of Slack's Claude Tag and lock-in incentives. 844K views.

kept_items.author: karpathy
kept_items.text: Karpathy says Twitter has never been this toxic and Reddit-like, that the algorithm encourages it, and that this is why he has been posting less.
kept_items.selection_reason: Notable practitioner observation from Karpathy on platform toxicity. 389K views.

kept_items.author: mattpocockuk
kept_items.text: mattpocockuk says vague skill instructions like Be thorough or Make it readable are no-ops that do nothing to change an agent's behaviour.
kept_items.selection_reason: Useful technical observation on agent-skill prompt writing. 236K views.

kept_items.author: _avichawla
kept_items.text: A new speculative-decoding technique reportedly took a 122B model from 250 to 1000+ tokens/sec with zero quality loss.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete inference-performance technical item; distinct topic.

kept_items.author: Kantrowitz
kept_items.text: OpenAI's Greg Brockman describes coming bidirectional voice models that process input at the same time they process output.
kept_items.selection_reason: Forward-looking product signal on bidirectional voice; sourced quote from gdb.
